translations.web: The consecrated things were six hundred head of cattle and three thousand sheep.
translations.bsb: And the consecrated offerings were six hundred bulls and three thousand sheep.
translations.kjv: And the consecrated things were six hundred oxen and three thousand sheep.
translations.asv: And the consecrated things were six hundred oxen and three thousand sheep.
